name: CaseTableSemanticRowGroup
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "table-semantic-row-group" (table). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: real <table> markup: thead/tbody row GROUPS, whose UA display is `table-header-group` / `table-row-group` - a formatting context with no box of its own
